Name: Horse Squeeze
Author: jorgamun
Description:
[size=3]This mod changes the hitbox for your horse so that you can squeeze through gaps that are 1 tile wide.

No other aspects of the horse are changed. In multiplayer games, each player that wants the functionality must install the mod.[/size]

[b][size=5]Installation Instructions
[/size][/b][list=1]
[*][size=3]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=3]Extract the contents of HorseSqueeze.zip to your StardewValley/Mods folder[/size]
[/list]
